ISR.headline: With 84.5% of ballot boxes counted, Netanyahu's bloc leads on 54 seats, 7 short of a majority. Eisenkot's bloc has 49 and Arab-led parties 17.
ISR.headlineIs: Þegar 84,5% kjörkassa hafa verið talin er blokk Netanyahus með forystu, 54 sæti, sjö sætum frá meirihluta. Blokk Eisenkot er með 49 og flokkar undir forystu araba 17.
ISR.sourceName: Central Elections Committee count, 12:34 local time, as reported by the Times of Israel
ISR.sourceNameIs: Talning yfirkjörstjórnar kl. 12:34 að staðartíma, samkvæmt Times of Israel
ISR.note: Neither bloc reaches 61 without the Arab-led parties. Seats per party at 51.5% counted (Ynet): Likud 27, Yashar 21, Joint List 12, Together 11, Democrats 9, United Torah Judaism 9, Yisrael Beiteinu 8, Shas 7, Otzma Yehudit 6, Religious Zionism 6, Ra'am 4. Below the 3.25% threshold: Reservists (2.7%), Amcha Yisrael (1.6%) and Haredi Public (0.2%). Double-envelope ballots, including soldiers' votes, are counted last; the final count is expected by Friday and official results on 4 November.
ISR.noteIs: Hvorug blokkin nær 61 án flokka undir forystu araba. Sæti flokka þegar 51,5% höfðu verið talin (Ynet): Likud 27, Yashar 21, Hadash–Ta'al 12, Beyachad 11, HaDemokratim 9, Yahadut HaTorah 9, Yisrael Beiteinu 8, Shas 7, Otzma Yehudit 6, HaTzionut HaDatit 6, Ra'am 4. Undir 3,25% þröskuldi: HaMiluimnikim (2,7%), Amcha Yisrael (1,6%) og Haredi Public (0,2%). Utankjörfundaratkvæði í tvöföldu umslagi, þar á meðal atkvæði hermanna, eru talin síðast; lokatalning er væntanleg fyrir föstudag og opinber úrslit 4. nóvember.
